summary: Defines the ENABLE command for IMAP. Most IMAP extensions can simply be used if the server supports them, but a few change server behavior and so need the client to opt in. ENABLE lets a client tell the server which of those extensions it understands. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Before a waiter brings a special menu, the guest says they can read it. ENABLE lets an email program tell the server which extra features it understands.

questions: how does an imap client opt in to extensions
